feedback.problem:
Let $r=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 7\end{aligned}]$ and $s=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $r$ onto $s.$

${\text{proj}}_{s}\,r=⟨$ 
{{field-1}}$,$
{{field-2}}$,$
{{field-3}}
$⟩$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{s}\,r & =\frac{r\cdot s}{s\cdot s}s \\  & =\frac{{r}_{x}{s}_{x}+{r}_{y}{s}_{y}+{r}_{z}{s}_{z}}{{s}_{x}^{2}+{s}_{y}^{2}+{s}_{z}^{2}}s \\  & =\frac{(-3)\cdot 1+2\cdot 0+7\cdot (-2)}{{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}+(-2)^{2}}s \\  & =\frac{-17}{5}⟨1,0,-2⟩ \\  & =⟨\,-\frac{17}{5},0,\frac{34}{5}\,⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
